market_summary: During the London session, major pairs and assets are displaying mixed consolidation and low-conviction order flow. EURUSD and GBPUSD are pushing into session resistance and upper ATR envelopes with bearish or neutral CVD divergence, warning against chasing longs without high-volume breakouts. US100 remains coiled directly inside its Value Area around VWAP and EMA50. BTCUSD is executing a low-volume minor retracement after breaking below session VAL and VWAP. Discipline dictates a full HOLD stance across all symbols pending London/NY overlap liquidity expansion.

signals.rationale: Evaluating confluence checklist: 1) Price is inside Value Area (VAL 1.10766 to VAH 1.10981) and trading below POC 1.10946, acting as a fair-value magnet. 2) CVD is NEUTRAL (+651) with negative slope (-646), showing lack of directional aggression. 3) Market session is LONDON_SESSION. 4) Price is holding above VWAP (1.10842) and EMA50 (1.10873), indicating short-term structural support. 5) Candles are near the upper ATR band (1.10953), indicating stretch into resistance. 6) RVOL is 1.619 (no yellow spike >2.0). 7) Price is testing below Session High (1.10988) without breakout volume. GEX is null. Lack of volume breakout and position inside VA warrants patience.
